👉 [서울/경기/인천/부천 하수구 막힘 해결 문의] 1566-1038
https://hasugukings.com

[영상 핵심 요약]

이번 현장은 부천에 위치한 배관 구조가 좋지 않은 상습 막힘 빌라입니다. 고객님은 최근 타업체를 통해 하수구를 뚫었지만, 한 달도 채 되지 않아 다시 막히는 재발을 경험했습니다. 결국 하수구의제왕에게 "단순히 뚫는 것이 아니라 근본적인 배관 세척이 필요하다"며 SOS를 치셨습니다.

[충격적인 현장 상황]

현장에 도착해 내시경을 넣어본 결과는 충격적이었습니다. 200mm나 되는 대형 배관이 장비조차 들어가지 않을 정도로 꽉 막혀있었습니다. 타업체가 미처 발견하지 못하고 남겨둔 수많은 기름 덩어리들과...

무엇보다 배관을 완벽하게 틀어막고 있던 것은 마치 담요처럼 거대하게 뭉쳐있는 머리카락 폭탄이었습니다.

[하수구의제왕 솔루션]

이것이 바로 단순 통수 작업만으로는 해결되지 않는 반복된 막힘의 근본 원인이었습니다. 하수구의제왕은 전문 장비를 투입하여 이 거대한 이물질들을 완벽하게 제거하고 배관 내부를 새것처럼 만드는 하수구 스케일링 작업을 철저히 진행했습니다.

단순히 물길만 내는 것은 임시방편일 뿐입니다. 배관 재발 때문에 고통받고 계신다면, 배관의 본래 기능을 회복시키는 '세척'이 정답입니다.

id.title: Air Wastafel Meluap, Ketika Perbaikan Sendiri Tidak Mampu | Penyumbatan Minyak di Dalam Pipa
id.description:
Jika wastafel Anda meluap segera setelah hanya sedikit air yang mengalir, mungkin bukan hanya penyumbatan wastafel biasa.

(Situs Web King of Drains) https://bit.ly/49a8ZY1

(Pertanyaan Layanan) Seoul/Gyeonggi/Incheon: 1566-1038

(Lihat Ulasan Pelanggan) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJvf

Situs ini adalah contoh kasus penyumbatan saluran wastafel di sebuah apartemen di Sindorim-dong, Guro-gu, Seoul.

Setelah memeriksa bagian dalam pipa, kami menemukan bahwa lemak telah menumpuk jauh di dalam, menghalangi aliran air.

Dalam kasus penyumbatan yang parah seperti ini, sulit untuk menyelesaikan masalah hanya dengan pembersih saluran, air panas, atau alat penyedot. Hal ini karena bahan kimia mungkin tidak mencapai titik penyumbatan dengan benar, atau mungkin tidak dapat menghilangkan lemak yang mengeras di dalam pipa secara memadai.

Jika Anda mengalami gejala seperti wastafel meluap, penyumbatan berulang, atau gagal membersihkan saluran pembuangan, penting untuk mengidentifikasi penyebabnya di dalam pipa.

en-US.title: Sink Overflow, When DIY Cannot Do It | Oil Blockage Inside the Pipes
en-US.description:
If your sink overflows immediately after only a little water drains, it may not be a simple sink blockage.

King of Drains Website) https://bit.ly/49a8ZY1

Service Inquiries) Seoul/Gyeonggi/Incheon: 1566-1038

View Customer Reviews) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJvf

This site is a case of a sink drain blockage in an apartment in Sindorim-dong, Guro-gu, Seoul.

Upon inspecting the inside of the pipe, we found that grease had accumulated deep inside, blocking the water flow.

In cases of blockage this severe, it is difficult to resolve the issue with just drain cleaner, hot water, or a plunger. This is because the chemicals may not properly reach the point of blockage, or they may not be able to sufficiently remove the hardened grease inside the pipe.

If you experience symptoms such as sink overflow, recurring blockages, or drain cleaner failures, it is necessary to identify the cause inside the pipe.

Ketika kami pertama kali membuka bak penampung, kami menemukan campuran tisu basah dan lemak,

dan struktur saluran keluar yang berasal dari Gedung 102 juga tidak normal.

Kita perlu memeriksa strukturnya bersama-sama untuk memahami mengapa air menumpuk dan mengapa tersumbat lagi, daripada hanya melakukan pembersihan bertekanan tinggi.

Lokasi ini adalah contoh yang menunjukkan mengapa King of Sewers sangat mementingkan inspeksi di lokasi dan mendiagnosis penyebabnya sebelum memulai pekerjaan.

Untuk saluran pembuangan, menemukan alasan mengapa saluran tersebut tersumbat kembali jauh lebih penting daripada sekadar membersihkannya.

View Customer Reviews) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJvf

This is a site where the villa's communal sewer repeatedly clogged every 1 to 2 years,

and even experienced backflow through the floor pipes of the 2nd-floor bathroom.

When we first opened the sump, we found a mixture of wet wipes and grease,

and the structure of the outlet coming from Building 102 was also abnormal.

We need to examine the structure together to understand why the water accumulates and why it clogs again, rather than simply performing high-pressure cleaning.

This site is an example demonstrating why King of Sewers places such importance on on-site inspection and diagnosing the cause before starting work.

For sewers, finding the reason why it clogs again is more important than simply clearing it.

This is a site involving a villa's communal sewer that kept clogging every 1 to 2 years, even after high-pressure cleaning.

It is said that there was even an instance where water backed up through the floor pipes of the second-floor bathroom, flooding two households simultaneously.

This project involved not just clearing the pipes, but also opening the sump to identify the cause of the recurring blockages.

While clearing the sewer is important, identifying why it keeps clogging is even more crucial.

This is because the problem can only be accurately and definitively resolved once the cause is identified.

King of Sewers identifies the cause of the blockage through pipe endoscopy and on-site diagnosis, and we personally show you the condition after the work is completed.

snippet.description:
고압세척해도 또 막히는 빌라 하수구, 왜 이런 일이 반복될까요?

하수구의제왕 홈페이지)https://bit.ly/49a8ZY1
작업문의) 서울/경기/인천 : 1566-1038
고객들이작성한 후기 보기) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJvf

이번 현장은 1~2년마다 공용배관 하수구가 막히고,
그때마다 고압세척으로 뚫었지만 다시 문제가 생겼던 빌라입니다.

결국에는 2층 두 세대 화장실로 동시에 역류하면서
집 안이 물바다, 거의 수영장처럼 된 상황까지 발생했습니다.

현장에 도착해 집수정을 열어보니
배관 안에는 기름과 물티슈가 섞여 있었고,
출수구 구조 자체에도 문제가 있는 상태였습니다.

단순히 막힌 부분만 고압세척으로 뚫고 끝냈다면
이 하수구는 또 막힐 수밖에 없는 구조였습니다.

en-US.title: Villa drain clogged again even after high-pressure cleaning, the real cause of the backflow - A c...
en-US.description:
Villa Drains That Clog Again Even After High-Pressure Cleaning: Why Does This Keep Happening?

King of Drains Website) https://bit.ly/49a8ZY1

Service Inquiries) Seoul/Gyeonggi/Incheon: 1566-1038

View Customer Reviews) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJvf

This project is a villa where the shared drainage pipes clog every 1 to 2 years. Each time, we cleared them with high-pressure cleaning, but the problem persisted.

Eventually, water backed up into the bathrooms of two units on the second floor, turning the inside of the house into a flooded mess, almost like a swimming pool.

Upon arriving at the site and opening the sump, we found a mixture of oil and wet wipes inside the pipes, and the structure of the drain outlet itself was also problematic.

If we had simply cleared the clogged parts with high-pressure cleaning and stopped there, this drainage system was structured in a way that made it inevitable it would clog again.

Therefore, for this job, we not only removed the grease using high-pressure washing, but also inspected the internal condition using a pipe endoscope to accurately identify the true cause of the backflow.

For drains that clog again even after high-pressure washing, it is not just a simple blockage; we must also check the shared plumbing structure, the condition of the sump, and any foreign matter issues.

The King of Drains does not stop at simply clearing the blockage; we focus on solving the problem.

We identify the cause using a pipe endoscope and show you the condition after the work is done.

Service Inquiries) Seoul/Gyeonggi/Incheon: 1566-1038

View Customer Reviews) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJvf

This project involved unclogging a drain at a beef rib restaurant that had been blocked for 14 years.

Upon inspecting the pipes, we found that long-accumulated beef fat had completely clogged the interior.

King of Drains does not simply unclog the drain and stop there;

We use a pipe endoscope to check the condition before, during, and after the work.

This is because even if water drains on the surface, if fat remains inside the pipe,

there is a high probability that it will clog again.

This is a site where the restaurant owner remarked,

"Just like in the video, you really let me check with an endoscope after finishing the work."

If you experience recurring clogged restaurant drains, grease blockages in the sink pipes, or sewer backflow,

it is important to first check the inside of the pipes.

View Customer Reviews) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJv

This is the site of a clogged sink at Doosan We've Apartment in Haan-dong, Gwangmyeong.

The sink water was not draining properly, so we checked it with a pipe endoscope.

We found that grease sludge had accumulated inside the pipe, narrowing the water passage.

A clogged sink may not be a problem that can be solved simply by making a hole.

Since there is a possibility of re-clogging if grease residue remains inside the pipe,

it is important to identify the cause with an endoscope, remove the grease sludge, and then perform a drainage test.

아파트 싱크대가 갑자기 막혀 물이 내려가지 않는다면,
무조건 뚫는 것보다 먼저 배관 안 원인을 확인하는 것이 중요합니다.

이번 현장은 내시경으로 싱크대 배관 내부를 확인한 결과,
배관 안에 음식물 찌꺼기와 기름때가 쌓여 물길을 막고 있었습니다.

막힘 원인을 확인하고 해결하는 방식으로 작업합니다.

싱크대 물이 갑자기 안 내려가거나,
뚫어도 다시 막히는 증상이 있다면
업체를 부르기 전 작업 범위와 추가금 여부를 먼저 확인해보세요.

en-US.description:

Service Inquiries) Seoul/Gyeonggi/Incheon: 1566-1038

View Customer Reviews) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJvf

If you are curious about the cost of unclogging an apartment drain,

and if you have been frustrated wondering what work is actually done for 100,000 won, please watch this video until the end.

For clogged sinks and drains, simply "unclogging" them is not enough;

how the cause is identified, how the inside of the pipes is cleaned, and

how the results are presented after the work are far more important.

In this video, King of Drains demonstrates firsthand just how much work is actually done when quoting apartment and officetel sink clogs based on a 100,000 won rate.

If you need to make an inquiry, please click the link below.

Once you enter the website, there is a direct phone call button.

https://bit.ly/49a8ZY1

The King of Drains first identifies the cause of the blockage using an endoscope camera,

cleans out foreign matter inside the pipes using specialized equipment,

shows the post-work condition via the endoscope,

and finally, performs a sink drainage test so that the customer can verify the results themselves.

The reason we have completed over 8,000 apartment sink blockage repairs and accumulated 452 Google reviews over the past 3 years is because of our method of showing you the entire process, from the cause to the completion.

Before calling a company, be sure to check the following:

1. What work is included for that price

2. Are there any additional charges on-site?

3. Can you verify the work before and after yourself?

If you are curious about actual customer reviews,

search for "The King of Drains" on Google to check them out for yourself.

If you need to inquire about clogged apartment sinks, clogged officetel drains, or clogged pipes,

you can connect directly by phone via the link above.

"우리 집 싱크대는 잘 내려가니까 괜찮겠지?"
과연 그럴까요? 배관 속은 열어보기 전까지 아무도 모릅니다.

이번 현장은 겉보기엔 멀쩡해 보였지만, 배관 깊숙한 곳에 10년 전 공사 때 박힌 것으로 추정되는 폐주름관이 통로를 가로막고 있었습니다. 이런 이물질은 일반적인 장비로는 확인조차 어렵고, 대충 뚫기만 해서는 금방 다시 막힐 수밖에 없습니다.

단순히 물만 흐르게 하는 작업과, 막힘의 근본 원인을 뿌리 뽑는 작업은 하늘과 땅 차이입니다.
제대로 된 장비와 기술력이 왜 중요한지, 이 영상을 끝까지 확인해 보세요.

가족의 위생과 직결된 주방 배관, 이제 '진짜 전문가'에게 맡겨야 하는 이유입니다.

View Customer Reviews) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJvf

"My sink drains well, so it must be okay, right?"

Is that really the case? No one knows what's inside the pipes until they are opened.

At this site, the pipes looked fine on the outside, but deep inside, a discarded corrugated pipe—presumably embedded during construction 10 years ago—was blocking the passage. Such foreign matter is difficult to even detect with standard equipment, and simply clearing it roughly will inevitably cause it to clog again quickly.

There is a world of difference between simply restoring water flow and rooting out the cause of the blockage.

Watch this video to the end to see why proper equipment and technical expertise are so important.

This is why you must now entrust your kitchen plumbing, which is directly linked to your family's hygiene, to a 'real expert.'

en-US.title: You just wasted your money (5 contractors misdiagnosed) | Seongnam Sewer Service #Unclogging
en-US.description:
The King of Drains confirmed the real reason why the backflow wouldn't stop even after unclogging it 5 times using an endoscope.

King of Drains Website) https://bit.ly/49a8ZY1

Service Inquiries) All areas of Seoul/Gyeonggi/Incheon: 1566-1038

View Customer Reviews) https://share.google/9XuDNWqsiO9eorJvf

A plumbing company visited more than 5 times, but the bathroom backflow continued. It turned out they had simply unclogged it without an endoscope, wasting money by clearing only the wrong spots.

Indiscriminate work without an accurate diagnosis only results in financial loss.

■ On-site Diagnosis Results

Site: Jungwon-gu, Seongnam-si

Location of Misdiagnosis by Other Company: Basement Piping (Unrelated to the Actual Cause)

Actual Blockage Location: 2nd Floor Ceiling Horizontal Piping (Same-day Confluence Point with Common Piping)

Cause of Blockage: Solidification of a Large Amount of Oil Sludge Due to Poor Tilt of the Horizontal Piping

■ Work Details

After accurately identifying the pipe structure, a 6mm flex shaft was inserted into the actual target blockage section.

Complete crushing of oil sludge in the source area and endoscopic verification of normal water flow status completed.

#CloggedDrain #DrainUnclogging #CloggedSink #UncloggingSink #BathroomClog

이 현장은 인테리어 공사 중인 세대로, 이전 집주인 때부터 화장실 역류가 있었던 곳입니다. 배관 설비 업체가 5번 넘게 방문했음에도 해결되지 않았고, 심지어 지하 고압세척까지 했지만 소용이 없었습니다.

하수구의 제왕이 도착해 드레인 내시경으로 배관 내부를 직접 확인했습니다. 문제는 두 가지였습니다. 301호 화장실 배관이 공용배관과 합류한 이후 이어지는 횡 배관의 기울기가 좋지 않아, 수십 년치 기름이 그대로 쌓여 있었던 것입니다. 이전 업체는 전혀 관계없는 지하 배관을 작업했기 때문에 당연히 해결이 안 됐습니다.

6mm 샤프트로 배관에 붙은 기름을 모두 눈으로 보면서 제거하고, 배관 구조를 집주인께 설명해드렸습니다. 작업 후 물이 빠르게 흘러가는 것을 내시경으로 직접 확인하실 수 있습니다.

There is a reason why the more you pour Drapung, the more severely the drain clogs.

If you repeatedly pour Drapung or drain cleaner into pipes where grease has accumulated, the grease and Drapung components mix together and harden like stone. Upon inspecting the site with a pipe endoscope, the inside of the pipe was found to be filled with white Drapung residue and lumps of grease.

If you are experiencing a clogged sink drain, washing machine backflow, or a situation that cannot be resolved with drain cleaner or drain cleaner, it is highly likely that the problem lies with the grease in the pipes.

A problem occurred in a villa in Sangnok-gu, Ansan-si, where water overflowed from the veranda sink and floor drains every time the washing machine was run. However, this might not be just a simple clogged drain.

In this video, we show you the entire process of accurately diagnosing the cause of the clogged drain and sewer backflow using a pipe endoscope, and neatly resolving the issue.

00:00 Water overflows when running the washing machine? Checking the site

01:00 Initial diagnosis of the cause of the drain blockage using a pipe endoscope

01:28 Found! Deeply Inserted Corrugated Pipe Causes Drain Blockage

03:23 Drain Trap Fallen Inside the Pipe – The Real Cause of Sewer Backflow

09:07 Removal of Grease Clumps Inside the Pipe

10:09 Corrugated Pipe Reorganization and Normalization of Drainage Flow

10:38 Final Confirmation via Endoscope – Drain Blockage Completely Resolved

✅ This video is essential for the following people:

- Those whose veranda floor or sink overflows while using a washing machine

- Those who do not know the cause—whether it is a drain blockage or a sewer blockage

- Those experiencing recurring sink blockages

- Homes with frequent sewer backflow

🔍 Two Causes for This Site

1. The kitchen sink corrugated pipe was inserted too deeply into the pipe, obstructing water flow

2. A drain trap fell inside the pipe, creating a structure where foreign matter accumulates

→ This is a typical case where the system held out normally, but the moment a large amount of water flows down at once, like from a washing machine, it leads to sewer backflow.

There's a real reason why sinks are clogged so often. Surprisingly, people often overlook this!

When we inspected the pipes at this site with an endoscope, we discovered a piece of old corrugated pipe that had been carelessly cut and left behind by the previous worker, deeply lodged, blocking all grease and debris. What if your sink is particularly clogged? There's a high probability that this hidden culprit lies deep within the pipes, unseen by the naked eye. Identifying the exact cause is the first step to a perfect solution!

트래펑을 아무리 부어도 하수구가 계속 막히신다면?
이 영상이 그 이유를 알려드립니다.
경기도의 한 전원주택에서 싱크대와 세탁기를 사용할 때마다 창고 바닥 배관에서 물이 역류하는 현상. 직접 트래펑과 뜨거운 물을 반복해서 부었지만 해결되지 않았던 이유는 따로 있었습니다.

en-US.title: Is this not intentional? The greatest villain ever, who shoved three traps into the drain. When t...
en-US.description:
🌐 Website: https://bit.ly/49a8ZY1 📞 Inquiries - Seoul/Gyeonggi/Incheon: 1566-1038 Busan: 1811-0512
#DrainClog #DrainUnclogging #BathroomDrain #DrainUnclogging #DrainTrap

We received an urgent call from a resident of a villa in Mok-dong, Gangseo-gu, complaining that the water in the fourth-floor bathroom was not draining and was taking forever. When we arrived at the scene and used a pipe endoscope... I couldn't believe my eyes.

It wasn't just a hair or foreign object clogging the pipes. We discovered three layers of drain traps, meant to block odors, were stacked deep within the pipes! 😱 The client said there were suspicious circumstances, but unfortunately, we only had circumstantial evidence and no way to prove it. It was a frustrating situation.

Even Team Leader Park, who was working on the project, was so shocked that he exclaimed, "Who stacked a tower on the pipes?!" It was a real struggle to remove the three traps stuck in the narrow pipes, but like the king of sewer work, he completely removed them and cleared the clog.

Was this intentional, or was it just a freaking coincidence? Watch the video to see for yourself! If your toilet water drains slower than usual or backs up, don't ignore it. Get a plumbing endoscope to determine the exact cause.

06:22 Team Leader Park tries to persuade and coax the foreign object

단순히 머리카락이나 이물질로 막힌 게 아니라, 배수구 냄새 차단용 트랩이 무려 3개나 배관 속에 겹겹이 쌓여있었습니다! 😱 의뢰인분께서는 의심 가는 정황이 있다고 하셨지만, 안타깝게도 심증만 있을 뿐 증명할 방법은 없는 답답한 상황이었죠.

작업을 진행하던 박팀장님도 너무 황당해서 **"누가 배관에 탑을 쌓아놨어?!"**라고 외치실 정도였습니다. 좁은 배관 속에서 꽉 끼어버린 트랩 3개를 빼내느라 정말 진땀을 뺐지만, 하수구의제왕답게 완벽하게 제거하고 시원하게 뚫어드렸습니다.

누군가 고의로 넣은 것인지, 아니면 정말 말도 안 되는 우연인지… 영상으로 직접 확인해 보세요! 화장실 물이 평소보다 느리게 빠지거나 역류한다면, 절대 방치하지 마시고 배관 내시경으로 정확한 원인을 파악해야 합니다.

유독 자주 막히는 싱크대, 뚫어도 뚫어도 역류한다면 배관 깊은 곳을 의심해 봐야 합니다. 일반인은 절대 모르는 싱크대 막힘 원인 2위, 과연 무엇일까요?

"유튜브에서 여기가 제일 꼼꼼하게 하더라고요."

en-US.description:
(Sewer King Review) https://bit.ly/49a8ZY1 (For inquiries about work) Seoul/Gyeonggi/Incheon: 1566-1038)

What do homes with particularly clogged sinks have in common? The second-worst cause of clogged drains
(You know the number one? Grease!)

If your sink clogs frequently, and even after unclogging it, the drain backs up, you should suspect something deeper in the pipes. What is the second-most common cause of sink clogs that most people never know?

This particular site was chosen by my daughter, who had been meticulously comparing numerous drain companies on YouTube. She trusted us, "Sewer King," to help her parents' home.

"They said on YouTube that this company is the most thorough."

To repay her trust, we thoroughly examined the inside of the pipes with an endoscope camera. Sure enough, a piece of old corrugated pipe, carelessly cut by a previous contractor, was lodged deep inside the pipe, and a massive, hardened grease clogged the common pipe. Watch the video to see the refreshing process of thoroughly removing and cleaning the hidden causes that other companies missed!

When your drain is clogged, we'll unblock it with the utmost care, as if we were fixing your own family's home. Drain clogs are truly the king of drains!👑

snippet.title: 99%사람들이 모르는 하수구 또 막히는 진짜이유
snippet.description:
"뚫어도 뚫어도 또 막히는 아파트 싱크대, 진짜 이유는 '배관 벽'에 있습니다! 🧐" 하남시 덕풍동 한솔솔파크 현장에서 확인한 충격적인 배관 내부 실체!

en-US.title: Never put this in a restaurant toilet (beware of the repair bill explosion)
en-US.description:
"Wet wipes, you think it's okay to flush them down the toilet? Absolutely not! 🚫" Even if your pipes look fine on the outside, they may already be clogged with clumps of wet wipes.

🚩 Why are wet wipes a problem? Unlike toilet paper, wet wipes are made of synthetic fibers that don't dissolve in water. If they get caught in bends or elbows in your pipes, they can tangle with other debris, creating a massive "oil and fiber clump." This can ultimately lead to the entire toilet needing to be torn out.

✅ Today's Work Points: 1️⃣ Identifying the Cause: Recurring toilet clogs. An endoscope reveals the culprit: The narrow toilet pipe structure. And the wet wipes that get caught there. 2️⃣ Deploying Specialized Equipment: Techniques that securely snag the debris without damaging the toilet. 3️⃣ Checking the Results: The water flows smoothly! (This is the King of Drains class.)

One small habit can save you a lot of money on repairs. Please be sure to dispose of wet wipes in the trash! 🗑️

TV에도 많이 소개된 여성 중식 셰프가 운영하는 유명 중식당에서 직접 의뢰가 들어왔습니다. “주방 그리스트랩 쪽으로 물이 잘 안 내려간다”는 내용이었는데요.

현장 도착 후, 문제가 있다는 그리스트랩을 열고 싱크대 물을 틀어보니
물이 바로 빠지지 않고 트랩 안에서 차오르는 증상이 확인됐습니다.

곧바로 배관 내시경으로 상태를 확인했습니다.
내시경으로 기름 덩어리 일부를 건드리자 물이 잠깐 빠지기 시작했지만,
일정 구간에서 더 이상 진입이 안 되는 지점이 있었고
그 구간부터는 단순 배수 문제가 아니라 기름 축적 + 구조 문제 가능성이 높다고 판단했습니다.

그래서 바로 6mm 샤프트 장비로 기름 제거 작업을 시작했습니다.
작업 중에는 물이 차올랐다가 빠졌다가를 여러 번 반복했지만,
끝까지 밀어내며 배관 내부를 깨끗하게 정리했고
마무리로 다시 내시경을 넣어 잔여 기름과 흐름 상태를 최종 확인했습니다.

확인 결과, 매장에서 시관로로 이어지는 배관이 꽤 길었지만
대부분 구간은 기울기(경사)가 좋아 기름이 크게 쌓여 있진 않았습니다.
(매장 관리와 주방 관리, 기름 관리 모두 수준급으로  잘하시는 매장이라 생각보다 심각하진 않았습니다.)

다만 아쉬운 점이 하나 있었습니다.
그리스트랩을 지나 **3m도 안 되는 위치에 ‘엘보가 3연속’**으로 들어가 있어
유속이 떨어지고 흐름이 끊길 수밖에 없는 구조였습니다.
이런 구조는 관리를 아무리 잘해도 결국 기름이 걸리고 쌓일 확률이 높은 불리한 배관입니다.

✅ 오늘 영상은 “막힌 곳을 뚫는 것”에서 끝나는 게 아니라,
**왜 반복되는지(구조적 원인)**까지 함께 확인하는 내용입니다.

📌 이런 증상이 있으면 의심하세요
-그리스트랩/싱크대 물이 천천히 내려가거나 차오름
-특정 시간대(장사 피크)만 되면 배수 불량이 심해짐
-관리했는데도 자주 재발

-배관 내시경
-6mm 샤프트(기름 제거)

en-US.title: The more successful a house is, the faster it clogs? The problem was actually the plumbing struct...
en-US.description:
(Sewer King Review) https://bit.ly/49a8ZY1 (For inquiries, call 1566-1038)
#RestaurantDrain #SewerKing #DrainClog #DrainUnclogging #ToiletClog

We received a direct request from a famous Chinese restaurant run by a female Chinese chef who has appeared on numerous TV shows. The complaint was, "Water isn't draining properly toward the kitchen grease trap."

Upon arriving at the scene, we opened the grease trap and turned on the sink faucet.
We found that water wasn't draining immediately, but was rising inside the trap.

We immediately checked the condition with a pipe endoscope.

When we touched a clump of grease with the endoscope, water began to drain briefly.
However, there was a point where the grease flowed no further.
We concluded that it wasn't simply a drainage issue, but rather a structural issue with grease accumulation.

Therefore, we immediately began removing the grease with a 6mm shaft machine. During the work, the water surged and receded repeatedly,
but we pushed it all the way through to clean the inside of the pipe.
Finally, we inserted an endoscope to check for any remaining oil and the flow.

Our inspection revealed that the pipe leading from the store to the water main was quite long,
but most of it had a good slope, so there wasn't a significant oil buildup.
(The store's management, kitchen management, and oil management are all top-notch, so it wasn't as severe as expected.)

However, there was one drawback.

Less than 3 meters past the grease trap, there were three elbows connected in a row,
which inevitably reduced the flow rate and caused it to stop.

No matter how well-maintained, this type of pipe is prone to oil buildup and buildup.

✅ Today's video doesn't just "clear the blockage," but also
determines why the problem is recurring (the structural cause).

📌 If you have these symptoms, be suspicious:
- Grease trap/sink water drains slowly or rises
- Drainage problems worsen during certain times (e.g., peak business hours)
- Frequent recurrence despite maintenance

🔧 Equipment Used

- Pipe Endoscope
- 6mm Shaft (for degreasing)

※ The work method and scope may vary depending on the site structure.

[Video Summary] Naver's lowest price of 50,000 won? Free travel expenses? Have you ever trusted an ad and ended up paying 650,000 won on the spot? There's a sharp increase in cases of people being ripped off (overcharged) after calling a company in a hurry to solve a clogged sink or backflow in the drain.
This video reveals the inflated "additional cost" tactics of unscrupulous sewer companies that only experienced professionals would know about, along with two methods to ensure you're never fooled.

[💡 Before calling a plumbing company, make sure to check this!]

Q. Why do sewer unclogging costs vary from company to company? A. Some companies lure you in with a "bait price" (lowest price) and then charge excessive additional fees, such as equipment usage fees, chemical costs, and plumbing costs. Before your visit, it's important to clearly ask, "What is the total cost?" and "Are there any additional charges on-site?"

Q. Should I absolutely avoid "on-site estimates"?
A. Yes, it's best to avoid them. The more detailed and accurate your description of your symptoms is, the more likely you are to receive a proper diagnosis and an accurate price range during a phone consultation. Be wary of companies that insist on a visit.

en-US.title: Why you need to clean your drain with a pipe endoscope when it's clogged
en-US.description:
Unclogging a sewer without a pipe endoscope is like driving with your eyes closed.

📞 For inquiries about precise pipe endoscope diagnosis and work, call 1566-1038

★ Sewer King Review https://hasugukings.com
📞 Pipe Endoscope Purchase Link: https://smartstore.naver.com/mstechnology/products/10332284740

This video covers two real-life cases that demonstrate the importance of pipe endoscope inspection.

1. Clogged drain in a noodle restaurant (opened 1 year and 6 months ago)
Problem: Another company unclogged the drain with a spring, but the work was done without a pipe endoscope, resulting in a quick re-clogging.
Diagnosis: After inserting the pipe endoscope, a large amount of oily sludge was found clogging the pipe.
Solution: Real-time monitoring of the pipe interior with an endoscope allowed for a complete descaling and cleaning.

2. Sewer Odor in a Residential Building in Namyangju
Problem: No drain clog, but a foul, unexplained odor.
Diagnosis: A pipe endoscopy revealed clean pipes, but a poorly installed trap and a missing sump seal trap were found.
Solution: Installing a film trap in the drain and reinstalling the sump seal trap blocked the odor.
Conclusion: The key to resolving clogs is always identifying the exact cause through a **'pipe endoscopy'**.

⏰ Timeline
Check out key sections in the video.

00:00 Intro & Today's Site Overview

00:20 [Site 1] Clogged Drain in a One-Year-Old Noodle Restaurant
01:12 Shocking! A Glob of Grease Seen Through a Pipe Endoscopy
02:14 Clearing Pipe Scaling (Before & After)

03:55 [Site 2] Arriving at the Namyangju Building
04:53 Isn't Unclogging the Answer? A Reversal Revealed Through a Pipe Endoscope
05:30 What's the Right Sewer Trap?
06:30 Why You Should See a Pipe Endoscope

📝 Video Description
"I cleared it, but why is it clogged again?" Many business owners complain. The reason is simple: they didn't look inside the pipes themselves, relying solely on intuition.

This video shows two different situations.

The first is a noodle restaurant that uses a lot of oil. They had previously hired another company, but they only did spring work without a pipe endoscope. The grease remained, and the pipes clogged again after a year and a half. Watch the video to see what we saw inside the pipes with an endoscope, and to see how the pipes looked like new after scaling. (Beware of the thrill!)

The second is a site in Namyangju where the sewer smell was severe. This one wasn't a clog. The pipes were clean when inspected with an endoscope, but there was a problem with the "trap" that blocks the smell.

When it comes to sewer problems, an accurate diagnosis is the key to saving money.

snippet.description:
#하남하수구업체 #싱크대역류 #하수구막힘
#하수구의제왕 진짜고객들의 진짜리뷰 보러가기 👉 https://hasugukings.com

이번 영상의 핵심 포인트!
1. 하남시 빌라 1층, 3연속 엘보 배관 구조 때문에 싱크대 물이 계속 역류함.
2. 상하수도 전문가인 집주인이 바닥 공사를 하려 했으나, 아드님의 강력 추천으로 하수구의 제왕을 호출.
3. 공사 없이 6mm 플렉스 샤프트로 배관 손상 없이 기름만 완벽 제거 후 해결 완료.

하수구의 제왕 팀이 다녀왔습니다!
이번 의뢰인은 하남시에서 상하수도 공사를 직접 하시는 전문가 사장님이셨습니다.

하남시에 위치한 한 빌라 1층 세대의 세입자분이 싱크대를 사용할 때마다 물이 시원하게 내려가지 않고 역류하는 증상이 반복되어 긴급하게 방문했습니다.

하수구의제왕이 내시경 검사 결과, 배관이 **'3연속 엘보(ㄱ자 꺾임)'**로 되어 있어 구조적으로 기름이 쌓일 수밖에 없는 상태였습니다. 배관은 이미 20년 묵은 기름 슬러지들로 꽉 막혀 있었습니다.

집주인분께서는 상하수도 전문가이시다 보니, "그냥 싱크대를 뜯고 배관 공사를 새로 해야 한다"고 판단하셨습니다. 하지만 아드님께서 **"아버지, 고생하지 말고 하수구의 제왕 부르자"**고 설득하여 저희에게 연락을 주셨습니다.

하수구의제왕은 과연 문제를 해결했을까요? 네! 배관 공사 없이 해결했습니다! 꺾임이 많은 배관에서도 유연하게 진입하는 6mm 플렉스 샤프트를 사용해, 배관에 무리를 주지 않고 기름만 살살 털어냈습니다. 내시경으로 공용 배관과 만나는 지점까지 깨끗해진 것을 눈으로 직접 확인시켜 드리고 작업을 마쳤습니다.

"배관 구조가 안 좋다고 무조건 공사해야 하는 건 아닙니다. 기술과 장비가 있다면 뜯지 않고 해결할 수 있습니다!"

en-US.title: Why a Son Talked Out of His Dad's "Let's Rip Out the Pipes" Suggestion [Hanam Sewerage Company]
en-US.description:
#HanamSewerCompany #SinkBackflow #DrainClog
#SewerKings See real customer reviews 👉 https://hasugukings.com

Key Points from this Video!
1. On the first floor of a Hanam villa, water kept backflowing from the sink due to a triple-connected elbow pipe structure.
2. The landlord, a plumbing expert, wanted to remodel the floor, but at his son's strong recommendation, he called in SewerKings.
3. The problem was resolved without any construction, using a 6mm flex shaft to completely remove the grease without damaging the pipes.

The SewerKings team is here!
This client was a professional owner who handles plumbing work in Hanam.

A tenant on the first floor of a Hanam villa came to us urgently because the water in the sink wouldn't drain properly and would constantly backflow whenever he used it.

The Sewer King's endoscopic examination revealed that the pipes were constructed with a triple elbow (L-shaped bend), which structurally inevitably led to grease buildup. The pipes were already clogged with 20 years of grease sludge.

The landlord, a plumbing expert, decided to simply tear out the sink and rebuild the plumbing. However, his son persuaded him, saying, "Dad, don't bother. Let's call the Sewer King!" and contacted us.

Did the Sewer King actually solve the problem? Yes! We did! We solved it without any plumbing work! Using a 6mm flex shaft that flexibly penetrates even the most bendy pipes, we gently removed the grease without putting any stress on the pipes. We confirmed with our own eyes through the endoscopic examination that the pipes were completely clean, even up to the point where they meet the common pipes. We then completed the work.

"A poorly constructed pipe doesn't necessarily require renovation. With the right technology and equipment, we can fix it without tearing it down!"

*Timeline
00:00:00 Highlights & Site Introduction
00:01:25 Endoscopic examination and identification of the cause of the problem - The main problem was the pipe structure with multiple bends
00:03:57 Equipment deployment and cleaning - Pipe scaling using Shaft Flex
00:06:03 Identification of areas where the pipe slope was reversed (cause of blockage)
00:06:55 Work result review and conclusion - Confirmation of the pipe condition and structure with the customer and analysis of the cause

snippet.description:
#마포구하수구 #하수구역류 #집수정청소
#하수구의제왕 진짜고객들의 진짜리뷰 보러가기 👉 https://hasugukings.com

현장: 서울 마포구 빌라 1층
증상: 화장실 및 세탁실 바닥 하수구 역류
원인: 집수정에서 시관로로 나가는 배관 막힘 및 배관 구조 문제
해결: 배관 내시경 탐지로 진짜 원인을 찾아내어 샤프트 스케일링 작업 (배관 통수)
사전에 전화로 고지드린 금액 그대로 현장 추가금 없이 문제 해결하였습니다.

서울 마포구 빌라 1층 세대에서 화장실과 세탁실 바닥으로 물이 역류한다는 다급한 의뢰를 받고 유튜브 24만 구독자가 증명하는 대한민국 No.1 배관 케어 전문가, 하수구의 제왕이 출동했습니다.

단순히 집 안쪽 배관만 뚫으면 당장은 물이 빠지겠지만, 얼마 못 가 다시 막힐 것이 뻔해 보였습니다. 저희는 근본적인 원인을 찾기 위해 내시경 검사를 진행했고, 그 결과 집수정에서 시관로(시 하수관)로 나가는 출구 배관이 기름과 이물질로 꽉 막혀 있는 것을 발견했습니다.

이번 현장은 집수정 높이가 배관보다 낮아 구조적으로 물과 기름이 고일 수밖에 없는 험난한 곳이었습니다. 물이 가득 차 배관을 찾기도 힘들었지만, 포기하지 않고 8mm 플렉스 샤프트 장비로 단단한 기름 슬러지를 모두 분쇄하여 통수시켰습니다.

타 업체처럼 실내 작업만 하고 끝냈다면 해결되지 않았을 문제입니다. 하수구의 제왕은 시간이 걸리더라도 배관의 구조적인 문제점까지 파악하여, 싱크대 배관 단독 분리라는 장기적인 솔루션까지 확실하게 제공해 드렸습니다.

en-US.title: If your Mapo-gu villa's first-floor backflow problem persists even after clearing it, the culprit...
en-US.description:
#MapoguSewer #SewerOverflow #GutterCleaning
#SewerKings See real reviews from real customers 👉 https://hasugukings.com

Site: 1st floor villa in Mapo-gu, Seoul
Symptoms: Backflow in the drainage pipes leading from the sump to the city drain and structural problems
Solution: Using a pipe endoscope to identify the real cause, we performed shaft scaling (pipe drainage) on the site.
We fixed the problem at the exact price we had previously agreed to over the phone, without any additional charges.

Kings of Sewers, Korea's No. 1 plumbing care expert with 240,000 YouTube subscribers, responded to an urgent request for water backflow from the bathroom and laundry room floor of a first-floor villa in Mapo-gu, Seoul.

Simply unclogging the internal pipes would drain the water immediately, but it seemed obvious that the blockage would reoccur soon. We performed an endoscopic examination to determine the root cause, and discovered that the outlet pipe from the sump to the city sewer was clogged with grease and debris.

This site was a challenging one, as the sump was lower than the pipe, creating a structural problem where water and grease would inevitably accumulate. Finding the pipe was difficult due to the water filling the area, but we persevered and used an 8mm flex shaft machine to break up all the solid grease sludge and drain the water.

This problem would not have been resolved if other companies had only done the interior work. Sewer King, despite the time it took, identified the structural problems in the pipe and provided a reliable, long-term solution: the isolation of the sink pipe.

snippet.description:
타업체에서 비싼 돈 주고 뚫었는데 불과 한 달 만에 또 하수구가 역류한다면? 상상만 해도 끔찍한 일이 부천의 한 빌라에서 실제로 일어났습니다. 썸네일 속 200mm 배관을 꽉 막고 있던 '충격적인 그것'의 정체를 공개합니다.

👉 [서울/경기/인천/부천 하수구 막힘 해결 문의] 1566-1038
https://hasugukings.com

[영상 핵심 요약]

이번 현장은 부천에 위치한 배관 구조가 좋지 않은 상습 막힘 빌라입니다. 고객님은 최근 타업체를 통해 하수구를 뚫었지만, 한 달도 채 되지 않아 다시 막히는 재발을 경험했습니다. 결국 하수구의제왕에게 "단순히 뚫는 것이 아니라 근본적인 배관 세척이 필요하다"며 SOS를 치셨습니다.

[충격적인 현장 상황]

현장에 도착해 내시경을 넣어본 결과는 충격적이었습니다. 200mm나 되는 대형 배관이 장비조차 들어가지 않을 정도로 꽉 막혀있었습니다. 타업체가 미처 발견하지 못하고 남겨둔 수많은 기름 덩어리들과...

이번 현장은 부천에 위치한 배관 구조가 좋지 않은 상습 막힘 빌라입니다. 고객님은 최근 타업체를 통해 하수구를 뚫었지만, 한 달도 채 되지 않아 다시 막히는 재발을 경험했습니다. 결국 하수구의제왕에게 "단순히 뚫는 것이 아니라 근본적인 배관 세척이 필요하다"며 SOS를 치셨습니다.

[충격적인 현장 상황]

현장에 도착해 내시경을 넣어본 결과는 충격적이었습니다. 200mm나 되는 대형 배관이 장비조차 들어가지 않을 정도로 꽉 막혀있었습니다. 타업체가 미처 발견하지 못하고 남겨둔 수많은 기름 덩어리들과...

무엇보다 배관을 완벽하게 틀어막고 있던 것은 마치 담요처럼 거대하게 뭉쳐있는 머리카락 폭탄이었습니다.

[하수구의제왕 솔루션]

이것이 바로 단순 통수 작업만으로는 해결되지 않는 반복된 막힘의 근본 원인이었습니다. 하수구의제왕은 전문 장비를 투입하여 이 거대한 이물질들을 완벽하게 제거하고 배관 내부를 새것처럼 만드는 하수구 스케일링 작업을 철저히 진행했습니다.

단순히 물길만 내는 것은 임시방편일 뿐입니다. 배관 재발 때문에 고통받고 계신다면, 배관의 본래 기능을 회복시키는 '세척'이 정답입니다.
